items.source: Get the name of this task.

Get the time this task took in the requested time unit
(with decimal points in nanosecond precision).
items.translation: 获取此任务在请求的时间单位内所花费的时间（以纳秒精度包含小数点）。

items.source: Get the time this task took in milliseconds.
items.translation: 获取此任务所花费的时间（以毫秒为单位）。

items.source: Get the time this task took in nanoseconds.
items.translation: 获取此任务所花费的时间（以纳秒为单位）。

items.source: Get the time this task took in seconds.
items.translation: 获取此任务所花费的时间（以秒为单位）。

items.source: Nested class to hold data about one task executed within the StopWatch.
items.translation: 嵌套类，用于保存 StopWatch 内执行的一个任务的数据。

items.source: Rod Johnson, Juergen Hoeller, Sam Brannen
